description.description: A series of frames depicting a video game interface transitioning into gameplay, followed by infrared footage of air strikes. The first frame shows a custom Wii-style menu for 'Operation Epic Fury'. The second frame shows a Wii Sports Golf gameplay screen where a character is about to swing. The third and fourth frames display real-world infrared (FLIR) or thermal imagery labeled 'UNCLASSIFIED' depicting large explosions at target sites.
